title: A caller crosses a downstream rate limit as its own traffic grows
source_note: Failure pattern (a client's legitimate traffic growth pushes it past a downstream service's per-client rate limit, so a fraction of its requests get 429 and fail) follows overload-handling guidance in the Google SRE Book. All services, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~10:40 UTC the recommendations widget is failing to load for about 15% of page views. It got worse through the morning. No deploys. Recommendations-service says its own health is fine.

signal_lines.msg: calls to the model-scoring API returning 429 Too Many Requests; ~4% of reco requests affected
our request rate to model-scoring API is 1180/s; the per-client limit for our key is 1000/s
~15% of reco requests failing on model-scoring 429; rate has grown ~25% week-over-week with traffic
model-scoring API is healthy for other clients; the 429s are our per-client quota, not an outage
added client-side caching of scores for repeat items + requested a quota increase; 429 rate falling

ground_truth.root_cause: recommendations-service calls an external model-scoring API that enforces a per-client rate limit of 1000 requests/second on its API key. The service's own traffic has grown ~25% week-over-week, and its outbound rate to the scoring API crossed 1000/s (now ~1180/s). The scoring API started returning 429 Too Many Requests for the excess, so ~15% of recommendation requests failed. There was no deploy and no outage - the scoring API is healthy for other clients. The cause is the caller's traffic growth crossing a fixed downstream quota. Recovery required cutting the outbound rate (client-side score caching) and requesting a higher quota.
evidence_path: recommendations-service WARN: model-scoring API calls returning 429 Too Many Requests
recommendations-service WARN: our outbound rate is 1180/s against a 1000/s per-client limit
downstream_429_rate rises to ~15% as outbound_rps climbs past the limit with traffic growth
the model-scoring API is healthy for other clients - this is our per-client quota, not an outage
429 rate falls after client-side score caching cuts the outbound rate and a quota increase is requested
ground_truth.fix: Add client-side caching of scores for repeat items and request a quota increase (done). Add a client-side rate limiter that stays under the quota with graceful degradation, and alert on approaching the downstream limit.
